selected_by_janus.reason: The direct 2013 six-channel waveform gate is blocked by a stable public archive boundary, so JANUS selected recovery of independent calibration-sequence/response provenance rather than repeating the blocked gate.

purpose: Determine what H10S calibration evidence is anonymously/publicly recoverable around the 2013 fault epoch, distinguishing raw sequence bytes from machine-readable numeric transfer functions, calibration-flag/timestamp tables, derived published curves, abstracts and access pointers.

historical_anchor.published_context: H10S1 electronic noise followed by varying cross-talk to H10S2/H10S3 and reported deployed UWS calibration-response changes.

classification_contract.raw_sequence_requires: A publicly fetched payload representing actual recorded/injected calibration sequence samples or an archive explicitly containing such samples; a PDF plot or prose description is insufficient.
classification_contract.numeric_response_requires: A publicly fetched machine-readable table/CSV/JSON/text array of calibration transfer-function values; plotted figures alone are insufficient.
classification_contract.flag_table_requires: A publicly fetched machine-readable list/table containing actual calibration start/end times or calibration-bit intervals; a statement that such a table exists is insufficient.
classification_contract.derived_figure: A publication/presentation may establish published response-change results and processing description, but cannot be silently promoted to raw sequence bytes or machine-readable numeric response.
classification_contract.access_pointer: A public page describing how controlled/contractual access may be requested is an access pointer, not the protected data itself.

historical_facts_to_verify_in_public_der: Calibration sequence includes pseudo-random broadband code/RBC and CW sinusoids, with a silence/zero-input segment described in the presentation.
Calibration data are recorded at shore and stored at the CTBTO IDC.
An IDC table contains calibration start/end times when the calibration flag bit is set.
Earliest calibration responses found through that IDC calibration-bit route were in 2013.
H10S1 changed by about 0.8396 dB between March and September 2013 in 1-100 Hz.
H10S2/H10S3 showed larger before/after differences and inverse trends relative to H10S1, with cross-talk/riser-failure interpretations retained as interpretations rather than proof.

decision_rule.PUBLIC_H10S_CALIBRATION_SEQUENCE_BYTES_R: At least one authoritative/public payload satisfies RAW_CALIBRATION_SEQUENCE_BYTES for H10S/HA10 around the relevant era.
decision_rule.PUBLIC_NUMERIC_H10S_RESPONSE_RECOVERED__: No raw sequence bytes are recovered, but authoritative machine-readable H10S numeric response or actual calibration timestamp table is recovered.
decision_rule.PUBLISHED_H10S_CALIBRATION_RESULTS_RECOV: Authoritative derived calibration results and/or processing description are publicly recovered, but neither raw H10S calibration sequence bytes nor machine-readable H10S response/timestamp data are recovered in the frozen public pass; controlled-access pointers may exist.
decision_rule.BLOCKED_CALIBRATION_PUBLIC_RECOVERY: No authoritative calibration-result source can be fetched sufficiently to classify the gate.

after_result: Freeze the exact public-recovery receipt append-only, then submit it and the updated whole-picture synthesis to the JANUS 17-role reverse council for the next discriminating gate.
